headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: NOR (17)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Bahrain Grand Prix from pole position, 2.3s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Arvid Lindblad made the biggest climb, from P22 to P10.
George Russell had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P20.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
There were 73 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 84 points over George Russell.
